test.title: Lua control flow: break, repeat/until (do-while)
test.source: function run() local total = 0 local i = 0 while i < 10 do i = i + 1 if i == 6 then break end total = total + i end local j = 0 repeat total = total + 10 j = j + 1 until j >= 3 return total end
